Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.persistence.model.ledger

Class KfeBalanceEntity

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.persistence.model.ledger.KfeBalanceEntity
@Entity public class KfeBalanceEntity extends Object
Persisted per-wallet/per-asset ledger totals and their observation/integrity metadata. Domain mutation methods keep monetary buckets nonnegative, increment the ledger nonce, and call validateInvariant() around balance transitions. JPA's version separately protects concurrent writes through optimistic locking.

  • Method Details

    • empty

      public static KfeBalanceEntity empty(UUID walletId, String asset, String initialHash)
      Creates a zeroed balance row for a wallet and asset, seeding both integrity markers with the caller-provided initial chain hash.
      Parameters:
      walletId - wallet that owns this balance
      asset - asset ticker, defaulted to BTC by KfeBalanceId when null
      initialHash - initial ledger-chain hash for the new row
      Returns:
      unsaved entity initialized with its composite key and integrity seed

    • reserve

      public void reserve(long amountSats)
      Moves a positive amount from available to locked funds and advances the ledger nonce.
      Parameters:
      amountSats - amount to reserve in satoshis
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the amount is not positive or an invariant is already broken
      IllegalStateException - when available funds are insufficient
      ArithmeticException - if the locked total or nonce overflows

    • settleReservedDebit

      public void settleReservedDebit(long amountSats)
      Permanently debits an already locked amount after settlement; it is removed from the locked bucket.
      Parameters:
      amountSats - amount to debit from locked funds in satoshis
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the amount is not positive or the invariant is broken
      IllegalStateException - when locked funds are insufficient

    • releaseReserved

      public void releaseReserved(long amountSats)

      Throws:

      IllegalStateException - when locked funds are insufficient

    • creditAvailable

      public void creditAvailable(long amountSats)
      Credits a positive amount, first paying down reorganization debt and adding only the remainder to available funds. This prevents a reversed chain credit from being recreated as spendable value.
      Parameters:
      amountSats - incoming amount in satoshis
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the amount is not positive or an invariant is broken
      ArithmeticException - if the available total or nonce overflows

    • reverseAvailableCreditForReorg

      public void reverseAvailableCreditForReorg(long amountSats)
      Reverses an earlier available credit after a chain reorganization, consuming available funds first and recording any uncovered remainder as reorg debt.
      Parameters:
      amountSats - credited amount to reverse in satoshis
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the amount is not positive or an invariant is broken
      ArithmeticException - if debt or nonce arithmetic overflows
